Field guide

Nonexistent directives and noneffective settings are not the same as a noindex tag. This paragraph deliberately contains the words nonexistent and noneffective so a substring match would misfire.

Why it matters

An auditor that matches directives by substring reports a blocker that is not there, and the team spends a day chasing it.

What to check

Read the parsed directive list, not the raw string. The list here is max-image-preview and nosnippet.

Snippet control

Nosnippet gates what an answer engine may quote from this page, which is a real finding worth reporting.
